name: Tidy Endermen
summary: Keeps endermen from carrying off grass, sand and flowers, so your landscape and builds stay the way you left them.
logoPrompt: A perfectly neat grass block with a tiny wooden fence around it, a glowing purple pearl hovering above it untouched, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: Endermen keep their hands to themselves.
bullets: No more holes in the ground
No stray blocks in your base

description: **Tidy Endermen stops endermen from picking up and placing blocks, so they no longer leave holes in your lawn or drop dirt into your builds.**
- Endermen leave grass, dirt, sand, flowers, pumpkins, melons, TNT and every other block where it is.
- They no longer put blocks down in random places.
- Everything else is unchanged: they still teleport, get angry when you look at them and drop ender pearls.
Import the .mcpack, then turn it on under Behavior Packs when you create or edit a world.
- Made for Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 and newer, without experimental features. It can be added to or removed from an existing world.
- An enderman that already carries a block keeps holding it and never puts it down.
- Like every behavior pack, it turns off achievements in the world it is added to.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
